Job details mentioned below- ​ 
 Title: Curam Developer   
 Location: Raleigh NC  
 Duration: 12+ Months   
 
 
 
 Curam Developer needed to assist with the development and implementation using Cúram Software. 

 
 
 
 

 •       Cúram V6 Certified Developer- Required 
 •       Social enterprise management experience.- required 
 •       Experience as a Cúram Developer with experience in the full life cycle of requirements through functional design and testing.- Required 
 •       Experience in problem identification and integration of technical skills to address and solve issues.- Required 
 •       Experience using the Cúram Enterprise Framework Components, Cúram Intelligent Evidence Gathering (IEG2), Cúram Express Rules for Triage (CERT).- Required 
 •       Experience using Oracle and Subversion.- Required 
 •       Technical knowledge in Eclipse, HTML, Cascading Style Sheets, and Web Services standards (SOAP and WSDL).- Required 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
